title: FrostLedger

criteria.requirement: Two seeded organizations North and South; hashed-password login/logout with server-side session cookies; viewer/operator/admin roles.
All shipment, reading, incident and export routes enforce tenant membership from the session; reject guessed cross-tenant IDs.
Create shipments with unique tenant-local reference, origin,destination and integer min/max temperature in tenths Celsius; require min<max.
List shipments with reference search,status filter,stable pagination and meaningful empty states.
Append custody transitions created->in_transit->delivered, with actor,time and location; reject backwards or skipped transitions.
Import JSON temperature readings with immutable eventId,timestamp and integer temperature; duplicate identical events are no-ops; conflicting duplicate payload returns409 atomically.
Accept out-of-order timestamps; recompute excursions as consecutive out-of-range samples in timestamp order; readings exactly at min/max are in-range.
Show a timeline/chart and an accessible equivalent table; each excursion indicates start/end and maximum deviation without inventing continuous measurements.
Operators open and resolve incidents with a required resolution note; retain chronological audit history.
Viewer can read but cannot mutate; admin can manage local users without removing the final admin.
CSV export obeys current filters, quotes correctly and neutralizes formula-leading customer text; no password/session fields.
Dashboard counts derive from current tenant data; data survives server restart; invalid batches leave no partial writes.

title: BenchHarbor

criteria.requirement: Two seeded organizations Birch and Pine; hashed-password session login/logout and member/manager roles.
Server-enforced tenant scoping on resources,bookings,maintenance,inventory and CSV; never trust client role/tenant fields.
Managers create resources with name and positive integer capacity; list/search/archive without deleting booking history.
Members book a resource over half-open UTC intervals [start,end); duration15minutes..8hours, integer seats1..capacity, nonempty purpose.
Concurrent reservations must not exceed capacity at ANY instant; touching endpoints do not overlap; enforce transactionally.
Idempotency-Key is required for booking creation, scoped to user: same payload replays same booking, changed payload returns409.
Members cancel own future bookings; managers cancel any with an audit note; cancellations release capacity.
Managers add maintenance blocks that reject overlaps with active bookings; blocks prevent future bookings, with clear conflict feedback.
Manager-only consumable stock adjustments use signed integers and immutable movement IDs; duplicates no-op, conflicts409, stock cannot become negative.
Calendar and accessible list views share the same data; filters by resource/date/status and mobile layout preserve actions.
Member cannot edit capacity,maintenance or inventory; all sensitive operations have actor/time audit entries.
Dashboard uses persisted counts/stock; safe filtered CSV export, clear invalid/loading/empty/success states, restart persistence.
